Markets.title: FPIs emerge as biggest sellers among anchor investors in IPOs' 30-day window: Sebi study
Markets.summary: Foreign portfolio investors were the largest sellers among anchor investors in initial public offerings during the 30-day post-lock-in window. According to a Sebi study, smaller IPOs experienced higher selling intensity and heavy exits that pressured stock prices.

Markets.title: Bill Ackman adds Netflix, Visa & Mastercard in biggest portfolio shake-up in years
Markets.summary: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman significantly restructured his portfolio by adding stakes in Netflix, Visa, and Mastercard. His funds also acquired shares in Alcon, Intercontinental Exchange, S&P Global, and Microsoft.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: On the recent expiry day, the Sensex rose 114 points while the Nifty fell over 40 points amid softer inflation and elevated crude prices. Investors remained cautious due to geopolitical risks, keeping the Nifty rangebound between key technical levels.

Markets.title: US stocks: Tapestry forecasts weak annual sales as Kate Spade struggles, shares tumble 15%
Markets.summary: Tapestry's shares tumbled 15% after the company forecast weak annual sales due to struggling performance at Kate Spade. Although quarterly profits beat expectations and Coach sales rose 14%, cautious North American consumer spending caused overall revenue growth to slow.

Markets.title: Sebi seeks public comments on review of Accredited Investor framework
Markets.summary: SEBI has proposed changes to the Accredited Investor framework to simplify accreditation and expand eligibility to nearly 400,000 investors. These updates aim to ease investor access to alternative investment products by including securities-market assets as an eligibility criterion.

Markets.title: Bank of Baroda raises $700 million in first overseas bond issue since 2019
Markets.summary: Bank of Baroda raised $700 million through three-year and five-year dollar bonds in its first overseas issue since 2019. Strong investor demand helped tighten the pricing, with the proceeds intended to leverage the Reserve Bank of India's special swap window.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
Geo-Political.summary: The mayor of Qusra stated that Israeli troops are ordering Palestinian families to leave their homes. Soldiers are reportedly using some of these evacuated houses as military barracks.

Geo-Political.title: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Nobel Peace Prize winner Dmitry Muratov told the BBC that Vladimir Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine. Muratov stated that the Kremlin leader can only destroy the country rather than conquer it now that the war is in its fifth year.

Geo-Political.title: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says
Geo-Political.summary: The World Health Organization chief states that the current Ebola outbreak, declared on May 15, is on track to become the deadliest in history. The epidemic has already resulted in more than 2,000 deaths and thousands of additional reported cases.

Geo-Political.title: Conditions on US aircraft carrier at sea for more than 250 days raise alarms
Geo-Political.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln has been deployed at sea for more than 250 days since November. Sailors aboard the aircraft carrier are facing food shortages, broken plumbing, and other potential harms.

Geo-Political.title: Person fined after using foghorn to wake sleeping polar bear
Geo-Political.summary: A person in Svalbard was fined after using a foghorn to wake a sleeping polar bear. Local regulations strictly prohibit needlessly disturbing, attracting, or pursuing polar bears in the region.

Geo-Political.title: Eurovision Song Contest 2027 to be held in Burgas, Bulgaria
Geo-Political.summary: Burgas, Bulgaria, will host the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest. This selection follows Bulgarian singer Dara's victory in this year's competition.

AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best industry course. They achieved this free visibility without paying for advertising or traditional optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade gap widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. Meanwhile, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% to $173.78 billion from the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: U.S. consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid volatile oil prices. This increase aligned with analyst expectations and could provide the Federal Reserve with greater flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, staying above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by higher food and fuel prices, compounded by risks from elevated global oil prices.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the twentieth consecutive year due to a strong economic growth outlook. The agency also projected India's GDP growth at 6.4% while highlighting fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment.

Data & Insights.title: The Sanjeev Sanyal interview: A new age of ideas for India
Data & Insights.summary: Sanjeev Sanyal states that artificial intelligence is making traditional university education obsolete. He also notes that improving employability, rather than just job creation, is India's primary challenge.

Data & Insights.title: India retail inflation likely remained unchanged at 4.4% in July: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: A Mint poll indicates India's retail inflation likely stayed at 4.4% in July despite rising food prices. This stability was driven by a favorable base effect and contained underlying inflation.

India.title: Analysis: 'Bandi Sikh' Issue Shows Panthic Politics Broadening Beyond Akalis
India.summary: The Shiromani Akali Dal's political influence and dominance over Panthic issues has declined due to party fragmentation. Consequently, Panthic politics, including the 'Bandi Sikh' issue, are now broadening beyond the party.

India.title: He Did Not Flinch: Akali Dal Leader On Sukhbir Badal Attack
India.summary: Shiromani Akali Dal leader Sukhbir Singh Badal was attacked while visiting a holy shrine. He was accompanied by his wife Harsimrat Kaur Badal and other family members during the incident.

India.title: Actor Darshan Stood On Renukaswamy's Chest, Had Fall Guys Ready: Accomplice
India.summary: An accomplice in the Renukaswamy murder case has provided the first detailed account of the events on June 8, 2024. The witness claimed that actor Darshan stood on the victim's chest and had accomplices ready to assist him.

India.title: Protesters Demand Case Against Anti-Khalistani Terrorist, Block Highway In Ambala
India.summary: Protesters blocked a highway in Ambala to demand a criminal case against Gursimran Singh Mand. They alleged that the administration failed to take action despite repeated representations.

India.title: SP Mookerjee's Contributions To Be Taught In Bengal Schools: Chief Minister
India.summary: West Bengal will include the contributions of Syama Prasad Mookerjee in school textbooks. The state government is also publishing a book about Mookerjee to mark his 125th birth anniversary.

India.title: Bar Council's Big Step On Students Opposing Chief Justice, Then A Withdrawal
India.summary: The Bar Council of India chairperson initially stated that NALSAR law graduates from 2026 would not be enrolled as advocates due to student protests against the Chief Justice. However, the council subsequently withdrew this directive.

General.title: Aerial footage shows derailed train
General.summary: A train has derailed near Lewes in East Sussex. British Transport Police have confirmed the incident using aerial footage.

General.title: UK sees hottest day of the year as 38.1C recorded in Kew Gardens
General.summary: The UK experienced its hottest day of the year after temperatures reached 38.1C at Kew Gardens. An amber extreme heat warning remains in effect for parts of England until midnight.

General.title: Five key takeaways from results day 2026
General.summary: Top grades and university admissions increased during results day 2026. At the same time, enrollment in technical subjects grew in popularity.

General.title: Son pays tribute to dad, 102, who died after allegedly being assaulted in pub
General.summary: Phillip Ormerod, 102, died in the hospital after being allegedly assaulted in a pub. His son has paid tribute following the confirmation of his death by police.

General.title: The key signs you may have damaged your eyes by looking at the eclipse
General.summary: Looking directly at the sun without eclipse glasses can damage your eyes. A key symptom of this solar retinopathy is blurred vision.

General.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
General.summary: Israeli troops have ordered families in the Palestinian village of Qusra to leave their homes following a settler siege. The military is reportedly using some of these evacuated houses as military barracks.
